summary: Tested 'Pedir a mi taxista de confianza' end to end. Backend: the existing test_trusted_driver.py passes 4/4. The new test_trusted_driver_extended.py, run through the public URL, passes 5/6. Client UI (390px) works: the checkbox is hidden for a client with no linked driver and shown above the fare button for a linked client; the confirmation alert mentions the 30 minutes; the status shows 'Esperando a tu taxista de confianza · le quedan 30 min para aceptar', and after the driver releases the ride it shows 'Tu taxista no pudo aceptarlo: enviado al resto de taxistas'. Driver UI (admin) works: the trusted-ride-alert modal appeared within 15 s with client name, origin and destination; the countdown ticks (29:30 -> 29:28); 'later' closes it and it does not come back on the next poll; 'accept' accepts the ride and opens Reservas; 'release' sends the ride to the open pool (checked in the DB); the label 'emisora-trusted-label-<id>' shows '★ Te pide a ti · 29 min para aceptar'. One bug: a scheduled ride more than 12 h ahead with the option ticked shows the wrong message to the client.

minor.issue: The ride is already exclusive (dispatch_scope='assigned') so exclusive_until is never set, but preferred=true. In EmisoraClient 'Mis servicios' the condition `dispatch_scope==='assigned' && exclusive_until` is false, so the client wrongly sees 'Tu taxista no pudo aceptarlo: enviado al resto de taxistas' for a ride that is still exclusive to their driver. Fix: set preferred=false when the ride is already assigned by the 12h rule, or give the UI a separate message when exclusive_until is null and dispatch_scope is 'assigned'.

Does not call _release_expired_preferred_rides first. After the window ends, a ride stays 'assigned' (other drivers get 403) until some list endpoint is called. In practice this is fine because the driver offers list triggers the release.

ui_bugs.issue: After 'Solicitar taxi' the form is reset but both suggestion dropdowns (origin and destination) stay open and cover the Destino and Pasajeros fields and the trusted-driver checkbox. This may be pre-existing.

issues: A 'Decidir luego' dismissal is only kept in memory (useRef), so the modal comes back after a page reload or new login. Acceptable, but consider storing it in AsyncStorage.
The 'Activas' and 'ASAP' counts are capped at 50 because the endpoint has limit(50), so 50 may not be the real number.

action_items: Fix the wrong client message for scheduled rides more than 12h ahead with prefer_my_driver=true (preferred=true but exclusive_until=null).
Optional: close the autocomplete dropdowns after a ride is created.
Optional: call _release_expired_preferred_rides inside accept/reject for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: rides.py create_ride line 881: `associated_driver_id if dispatch_scope == 'assigned' else associated_driver_id` gives the same value in both branches (dead ternary).
rides.py is over 1500 lines; consider splitting the client, driver and ratings routers.
EmisoraBanner trustedAction hides the modal even when the API call fails (for example a 409 when another driver took the ride). It shows a window.alert, which is OK.

success_rate.backend: 90% (9/10; the 1 failure is the scheduled-ride flag bug)

seed_data_creation: Clients +34600999401-406 and +34600999501-503 (names TEST_*) are linked to admin. All test rides were cancelled afterwards with `python ui_setup_trusted.py cleanup`; there are 0 pending preferred rides left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use ui_setup_trusted.py: 'sessions' writes the linked and unlinked client sessions to stdout (save to /tmp/sess.json); 'ride <name>' creates a trusted ASAP ride for admin; 'cleanup' cancels TEST rides. Client UI login: set localStorage appRole=client, emisora_client_token and emisora_client_info (the client JSON). Driver: appRole=driver, then log in with admin/admin through the UI inputs (placeholder 'Nombre de usuario' / 'Contraseña', data-testid login-button).
